The '''Passage Rite''' was a ceremony held during the [[Semi-summer festival]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vintrus]].

[[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]] claimed that he acquired his "Q3" alias by undergoing this ceremony.
